summary.tagline: Explore ancient peatlands and grazing herds in England's oldest nature reserve.
summary.seo_title: Wicken Fen National Nature Reserve Guide

travel.headline: Monitor seasonal trail access and parking requirements
travel.reservation: Entry generally does not require advanced booking, but non-members must use pay-and-display machines or the JustPark app for parking. National Trust members should scan their cards to receive a free ticket. Check official status for the Summer Nature Trail, which is strictly restricted to certain months to protect the peat.

days.title: Ancient Fenland and Iconic Landmarks

stops.name: Sedge Fen
stops.detail: Walk the circular Boardwalk to view the historic windpump and look for grazing Konik ponies across the undrained landscape.

days.driving: Allow 30-40 minutes from Cambridge; conditions vary.
days.note: The Boardwalk and Woodland Walk are accessible year-round, while the Summer Nature Trail is typically restricted to June through September.

intel.title: Lode Lane Parking
intel.text: The main car park is located halfway down Lode Lane; blue badge holders park free of charge. Visitors must walk from the car park down the lane to reach the Visitor Centre and start points.

intel.title: Path Accessibility
intel.text: Boardwalk and Woodland Walk routes are accessible, though assistance dogs only are permitted on these specific paths. The Lodes Way cycle path is open to all dogs under close control.

intel.title: Seasonal Trail Limits
intel.text: Access on Sedge Fen is limited to the Boardwalk and Woodland Walk from October to May. The extended Summer Nature Trail only opens during drier months to protect delicate flora.

intel.title: Local Services
intel.text: The reserve features an on-site cafe near the Visitor Centre for supplies. Evidence does not specify fuel station locations, so verify nearby services in Wicken or Ely before arrival.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: Specific mobile signal strength for the fenland is not documented in official sources. Users should download the JustPark app in advance if planning to use it for parking payments.

plan.arrival: Arrive at the Lode Lane car park, pay via the app or machine, and follow the pedestrian lane to the Visitor Centre for trail maps.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are suitable for the paved access lane; check for height restrictions if driving a tall RV.
plan.goldenHour: The windpump on Sedge Fen provides a focal point for late afternoon light, subject to seasonal closing times.
